_comment: MAINT-35-06. Pinned fuzzer corpora, swept by the lexer invariants and judged by the parse
oracle. Pinned by ARCHIVE sha256 rather than a commit SHA (as corpus.json uses), because these
are GitHub release assets rather than git trees — a weaker pin, and the reason the checksum is
mandatory: it is the only thing that would notice an asset re-uploaded in place.
luaLevel selects which pinned luac judges the member; 5.1 is squeek502's fuzz target.
